popup.hintTop: Recommended: use the bar at the top-left of the video page (Start / End). The popup closes when you click the video.
popup.queueEachTitle: Each checked clip becomes its own file
popup.queueMergeTitle: Join the checked clips into one file, in this order (at least 2)
popup.streamsHint: On embed/.php pages, send from a stream here. On YouTube and similar sites, the buttons above are enough (page URL).
popup.hintFooter: Clips from the extension — downloads go to your PC via the Clip-Direct web UI by default.
popup.status.webUiOpened: Web UI opened — progress and PC download there.
popup.status.reloadExtension: Extension was updated — reload this page (F5).
popup.status.startFailed: Start failed — use the bar at top-left on the page
popup.status.sent: Sent — see progress/download in the web UI.
popup.status.barShown: Bar should be visible on the page
popup.stream.cutOneTitle: Only checked clips, each as its own file
popup.stream.mergeTitle: Merge the checked clips into one file
popup.stream.fullTitle: Download entire stream without cut markers
popup.referer.label: Referer: {origin}
options.title: Clip-Direct Extension settings
options.noteDefault: Default: finished files are saved to your PC via the Clip-Direct web UI (browser download).
options.serverNote: Same URL for jobs and the web UI. Local: http://localhost:8090/ — Synology: http://192.168.178.27:8090/ — save, then use the Web-UI button.
options.clipEncodeNote: Preserve uses stream copy at HLS segment boundaries (best for pixel comparison tools). Exact re-encodes for frame-accurate in/out points.
options.postRenderNote: After the clip is done, re-encode it with constant frame rate, a keyframe at the start and re-synced audio. Fixes the 'last frame frozen for ~2s' and keyframe bugs in editors. Slower and slightly re-compressed.
options.openUiAfterQueue: Open web UI after queue (single tab)
options.keepPlayback: Keep video playing in background tabs
options.keepPlaybackNote: Stops tube/CDN players from pausing when you switch tabs (keeps the CDN session warm). YouTube and Vimeo are always excluded. Reload the video page (F5) after saving.
bar.sendNoneTitle: No valid clip checked — check the popup
bar.reloadHint: Clip-Direct extension was updated — reload this page (F5)
bar.status.sent: Queued — download runs in this browser
popup.clip.empty: No clips yet. Set Start and End around the part you want.
popup.clip.pasteForStream: {count} clip time(s) in clipboard — use Paste times, then Cut on a stream.
popup.status.clipboardEmpty: No copied times — use Copy times first
popup.status.mergeNeedTwo: Need at least 2 clips checked for merge
error.shellPagePhp: This page (.php) can only be downloaded via a detected stream. Play the video, reload (F5), then use Cut on a stream — or check Detected streams in the popup.
error.hlsEmbedNoStream: No stream detected (turboviplay/emturbovid/dood). Play 10–20 s, reload (F5), open popup — then Cut on the cloudatacdn stream.
error.embedShellNotStream: That is the embed page (dood.video), not the stream. Play the video — choose cloudatacdn.com under Detected streams.
error.hlsSegmentOnly: Only an HLS segment was detected, not the playlist. Play the video briefly, reload (F5), then use Cut on the m3u8 stream in the popup.
error.needOriginalPage: This CDN needs the original video page as Referer. Play the video there, then send from the extension — do not open the .m3u8 URL in its own tab.
error.invalidClipRange: No valid clip — the end must be after the start. Fix it in the popup.
ui.subtitle: Clips from the extension — when Ready, auto-save (checkbox) or Save to PC.
ui.tabWarn: Multiple tabs with this page open cause duplicate save dialogs. Close the other tabs.
ui.empty: No jobs yet. Send a clip from the extension.
ui.autoSave: When Ready, open save dialog automatically (once per clip)
ui.autoSaveHint: Keep only one tab on this page open. Auto-save runs only in the visible tab.
options.apiTokenNote: Only if the server runs with CLIP_DIRECT_TOKEN. Leave empty otherwise.
options.shortcutsNote: Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Shift+S = mark start, Alt+Shift+E = mark end. Change them at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.
error.backendUnreachable: Clip-Direct server not reachable — is it running? Check the address in the extension settings.
error.tokenRequired: Server requires an API token — enter it in the extension settings.
error.originBlocked: Server rejected the request (origin not allowed).
progress.waitingBrowser: Waiting for the previous browser download…
progress.workerRestarted: Browser download was interrupted (extension restarted) — send again
